findings.title: Delivery is completed at the message's appointed limit
findings.claim: The commissioned message is defined by reaching its appointed recipient or limit: the command to convey and the completion test make the relay itself part of the duty.
findings.mechanism: The two focus occurrences of the delivery root place causing-to-reach beside the perfect completion form, while the exact cross-ayah comparator frames the messenger's charge as clear delivery. Their contact turns completion from a general ideal into the condition that makes the commission whole.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning becomes legible as a boundary on transmission: stopping short is not a smaller version of delivery, but a failure to complete the assigned relay.
findings.containment: This finding concerns the duty of complete conveyance and does not claim compelled reception, a particular audience response, or a lexical replacement of the focus verb's ordinary delivery sense.

epistemic.reason: The anchored published record and exact connection are strong, while the duplicate reader records remain legacy evidence and the comparator supplies target Arabic without target morphology.

findings.title: Protection preserves the outward relay
findings.claim: Divine protection is an enabling holdfast: it keeps the messenger secure for the outward work of complete conveyance rather than withdrawing the messenger from exposure.
findings.mechanism: The protection carrier at the focus is paired with the registered holdfast facet and follows the uncompromised delivery command; the exact 11:43 comparator independently distinguishes active preservation from a merely assumed worldly safeguard. The sequence makes protection support continued transmission.
findings.reader_payoff: Protection is perceived as mission-enabling security, so the final clause reinforces the delivery duty instead of interrupting it.
findings.containment: The claim is about the function of protection within this commission. It does not assert immunity from every harm, compel acceptance, or turn the holdfast extension into the direct local morphology.

epistemic.reason: The focus publication is trusted but graded weak, the duplicate reader records are legacy evidence, and the 11:43 comparator supplies a qualified external test without target morphology.

findings.title: Non-guidance appears as failed uptake after indication
findings.claim: Non-guidance is rendered as failed uptake after indication: inner sight and hearing close, signs are reversed, desire becomes the followed guide, and the route is repeatedly lost.
findings.mechanism: The focus guidance and truth-covering carriers meet later records of lost sight, refused hearing, reversal, following, self-inclination, and repeated loss. The sequence changes non-guidance from a bare absence into a patterned failure to receive and follow an indicated route.

findings.containment: The reading remains attributed to the supplied wider traces. It does not claim that every instance of non-guidance has the same psychological sequence or that the focus clause alone supplies the later morphology.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record supplies complete exact anchors and focus returns, but its branch segmentation remains legacy_unbound and several branches are unresolved in the packet.
